name: Cross-venue hedged market making
hypothesis: Post a quote only when hedge-adjusted expected spread exceeds all costs.
spec: Setup: Quote on one venue with immediately accessible hedge liquidity elsewhere. Entry: Post a quote only when hedge-adjusted expected spread exceeds all costs. Exit: After fills, hedge within a fixed time/price budget and reconcile both venues. Parameters to pre-register: quote_venue, hedge_venue, hedge_timeout, maximum_unhedged_exposure.
blocked_reason: needs queue/latency modelling and two-sided quoting, which the paper engine does not simulate
